title: A New Era at Apple: John Ternus Takes the Lead
subtitle: As the tech giant faces pressure to improve its AI strategy, the new CEO prepares for his first major product event.

summary.en: John Ternus has officially become the new CEO of Apple, taking over from long-time leader Tim Cook. He faces the difficult task of improving Apple's position in the competitive world of artificial intelligence. On September 9, Ternus will lead his first major product launch, which is expected to feature a new foldable iPhone. Industry experts suggest that the company's future direction under Ternus will become clearer in 2027. Despite these changes, Apple remains focused on creating new and innovative products for its global users.
summary.zh: 強恩·特努斯已正式成為蘋果公司新任執行長，接替長期領導該公司的提姆·庫克。他面臨著在競爭激烈的人工智慧領域中提升蘋果地位的艱鉅任務。九月九日，特努斯將主持他首場大型產品發表會，預計將推出新款摺疊式智慧型手機。產業專家認為，在特努斯領導下，該公司的未來方向將於二零二七年變得更加清晰。儘管有這些變動，蘋果仍致力於為全球用戶創造創新產品。

paragraphs.en: On September 1, 2026, a new chapter began for Apple. John Ternus officially became the company’s new CEO, taking over from Tim Cook. This change marks a significant moment for one of the world’s largest technology companies, as Ternus is only the third person to lead Apple since 1997. Tim Cook, who served as CEO for 15 years, will move into a new role as executive chairman.
paragraphs.zh: 二零二六年九月一日，蘋果公司（Apple）開啟了新篇章。強恩·特努斯（John Ternus）正式接替提姆·庫克（Tim Cook），成為該公司新任執行長。這項人事異動對這家全球最大的科技公司之一而言意義重大，因為特努斯是自一九九七年以來，第三位執掌蘋果的領導者。擔任執行長長達十五年的庫克，將轉任執行董事長一職。

paragraphs.en: According to Deutsche Welle (DW), Ternus has big expectations to meet. During Tim Cook’s time at the company, Apple’s share price grew by more than 2,000%, and the company sold over 3.1 billion iPhones. Ternus, who previously worked as a leading hardware engineer at Apple, spent the last five months working closely with Cook to prepare for this transition. In his first memo to staff, reported by The Verge, Ternus thanked Cook for his leadership and shared his excitement about the company’s future, noting that he feels honored to lead such a talented team.
paragraphs.zh: 根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，特努斯面臨著極高的期望。在庫克任職期間，蘋果的股價成長超過兩千個百分點，且該公司售出了超過三十一億支智慧型手機。先前擔任蘋果硬體工程主管的特努斯，在過去五個月裡與庫克密切合作，為此次交接做準備。根據科技媒體 The Verge 報導，特努斯在給員工的第一份備忘錄中，感謝庫克的領導，並表達了對公司未來的興奮之情，強調能帶領如此優秀的團隊讓他深感榮幸。

paragraphs.en: While the change in leadership is a major event, the company is also facing pressure to change its strategy regarding artificial intelligence (AI). AI refers to computer systems that can perform tasks that usually require human intelligence, such as learning and problem-solving. Many critics believe Apple has fallen behind its rivals in this area. As Deutsche Welle (DW) reports, AI is no longer just a temporary trend; it is a technology that will likely decide the future success of major tech companies. For Apple, the challenge is to find a way to lead in AI while maintaining its high standards for hardware and software design.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管領導層更迭是一件大事，但該公司也面臨著調整人工智慧（AI）策略的壓力。人工智慧是指能執行通常需要人類智慧之任務的電腦系統，例如學習與解決問題。許多評論家認為，蘋果在這一領域已落後於競爭對手。正如德國之聲報導，人工智慧不再只是暫時的趨勢，它是一項極可能決定大型科技公司未來成敗的技術。對蘋果而言，挑戰在於如何在人工智慧領域取得領先的同時，維持其在硬體與軟體設計上的高標準。

paragraphs.en: John Ternus will make his first public appearance as CEO at an autumn product launch event on September 9. The event, called "Surprise and Shine," is expected to be a major milestone. According to The Verge, Ternus has already told staff that the upcoming launch will be "phenomenal." Observers expect the company to introduce a new foldable iPhone and an updated version of Siri, Apple’s virtual assistant. These products are intended to show that Apple is still capable of major innovation.
paragraphs.zh: 特努斯將於九月九日的秋季產品發表會上，以執行長身分首次公開亮相。這場名為「驚喜與閃耀」（Surprise and Shine）的活動，預計將成為一個重要的里程碑。根據 The Verge 報導，特努斯已向員工表示，即將到來的發表會將會「非同凡響」。觀察家預期該公司將推出新款摺疊式智慧型手機，以及蘋果虛擬助理 Siri 的更新版本。這些產品旨在展現蘋果仍具備重大創新的能力。

paragraphs.en: However, industry experts suggest that we should not expect immediate changes in Apple’s overall direction. Francisco Jeronimo, an expert at the tech research group IDC, told Deutsche Welle (DW) that the products being shown in September were likely planned while Tim Cook was still in charge. Jeronimo believes that it will be 2027 before we can clearly see the specific strategy that Ternus wants to follow. He noted that the company has not yet shown a different way of behaving just because a new leader is in place.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，產業專家建議，我們不應預期蘋果的整體方向會立即改變。科技研究機構 IDC 的專家法蘭西斯科·傑羅尼莫（Francisco Jeronimo）向德國之聲表示，九月展示的產品很可能是在庫克仍掌權時就已規劃好的。傑羅尼莫認為，要到二零二七年，我們才能清楚看見特努斯想要遵循的具體策略。他指出，該公司尚未因為換了新領導人，就展現出不同的行事風格。

paragraphs.en: One of the biggest problems Ternus faces is Apple’s relationship with other companies in the AI field. In the past, Apple was known for controlling both the hardware and the software of its products. Now, the company must rely on outside partners for some of its AI technology. This has led to some difficult situations. For example, Apple made a deal with OpenAI in 2024 to add ChatGPT to the iPhone. However, this partnership has faced problems, and Apple even sued OpenAI earlier this year, claiming that the AI company stole trade secrets. Apple has also signed a deal with Google to use its Gemini AI models.
paragraphs.zh: 特努斯面臨的最大問題之一，是蘋果與人工智慧領域其他公司的關係。過去，蘋果以掌控產品的硬體與軟體而聞名。如今，該公司必須依賴外部合作夥伴來獲取部分人工智慧技術。這導致了一些棘手的情況。例如，蘋果在二零二四年與 OpenAI 達成協議，將聊天機器人 ChatGPT 加入智慧型手機中。然而，這項合作關係面臨問題，蘋果甚至在今年稍早控告 OpenAI，指控該人工智慧公司竊取商業機密。蘋果也與 Google 簽署了協議，以使用其 Gemini 人工智慧模型。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the pressure on Ternus to succeed is high. Whether he can keep Apple at the top of the tech world will depend on how he handles these AI challenges. While the September event will highlight new hardware, the real test for the new CEO will be how he manages the company’s long-term strategy in a world where AI is becoming more important every day. For now, the team at Apple remains focused on building the future, with Ternus promising that there are many more incredible products currently in the works.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，特努斯面臨的成功壓力極大。他能否讓蘋果保持在科技界的頂端，將取決於他如何處理這些人工智慧挑戰。雖然九月的活動將聚焦於新硬體，但對這位新任執行長而言，真正的考驗在於他如何在人工智慧日益重要的世界中，管理公司的長期策略。目前，蘋果團隊仍專注於打造未來，特努斯承諾，目前還有許多令人驚豔的產品正在研發中。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A distinct period or phase in history or a person's life.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （人生或歷史的）一個新階段、新篇章。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指書的章節，這裡比喻公司發展的新階段。文中：On September 1, 2026, a new chapter began for Apple.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make less progress than others who are competing with you.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 fall 和 behind 組成，意思與字面拆解不同，指進度不如人。文中：Many critics believe Apple has fallen behind its rivals in this area.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Being planned or prepared; currently under development.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個固定搭配，指某事正在開發階段。文中：Ternus promising that there are many more incredible products currently in the works.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason the upcoming September 9 product launch is considered a significant milestone for John Ternus?

options.A: It marks the first time Apple will release a foldable iPhone to the public.
options.B: It serves as his first public appearance as the new CEO of Apple.
options.C: It is the event where he will officially announce his new long-term AI strategy.
options.D: It is the date when Tim Cook officially retires from his role as executive chairman.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段第一句，John Ternus 將在 9 月 9 日的秋季產品發表會上以執行長身份首次公開亮相。選項 A 雖然提到了摺疊手機，但文章僅稱其為預期產品，而非里程碑的主因；選項 C 錯誤，因為專家指出新策略要到 2027 年才會明朗；選項 D 錯誤，Tim Cook 已經轉任執行董事長，而非在當天退休。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the products featured at the 'Surprise and Shine' event?

options.A: They are specifically designed by John Ternus to demonstrate his new leadership style.
options.B: They will likely fail to impress critics because they lack AI integration.
options.C: They are not necessarily reflective of John Ternus's personal vision for the company.
options.D: They represent a complete departure from the hardware standards set by Tim Cook.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，專家 Francisco Jeronimo 指出，9 月發表的產品很可能是在 Tim Cook 任內就規劃好的，因此無法代表 Ternus 個人的策略方向。選項 A 與文章觀點矛盾；選項 B 無法從文中推論，因為文章提到 Siri 更新；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到 Apple 仍需維持硬體設計的高標準，並未提到要完全拋棄過往標準。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'in the works' mean?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。片語 'in the works' 在此處意指「正在進行中」或「正在籌備中」。文章最後提到 Ternus 承諾還有許多驚人的產品正在籌備中，這符合語境。選項 B、C、D 皆與「正在開發」的含義不符，雖然文章提到了法律糾紛與外部合作，但該片語本身僅指開發狀態，不包含這些負面或特定的操作細節。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of the article regarding Apple's current situation?

options.A: The transition of power from Tim Cook to John Ternus and its impact on the stock market.
options.B: Apple's historical success in selling iPhones and maintaining high-quality hardware.
options.C: The legal battles between Apple and AI companies like OpenAI and Google.
options.D: The challenges and leadership transition facing Apple as it navigates the competitive AI landscape.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章的核心在於探討 Apple 在執行長更迭之際，如何面對人工智慧（AI）帶來的競爭壓力與策略挑戰。選項 A 太過狹隘，僅聚焦於人事變動；選項 B 僅是背景資訊；選項 C 僅是文章提到的眾多挑戰之一，並非全文主旨。選項 D 完整涵蓋了人事變動與 AI 策略挑戰這兩個關鍵主題。
